definitions.gloss: stick gum; slab gum; flat chewing gum
definitions.explanation: Chewing gum in the traditional flat, rectangular stick form, as opposed to pellet-type gum (粒ガム). A common everyday product in Japan.

examples.japanese: {板|いた}ガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧。
examples.english: To chew a stick of gum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{板|いた}ガム⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, pellet gum is more popular than stick gum.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{駄菓子屋|だがしや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{板|いた}ガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{買|か}っていた→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: When I was a kid, I often bought stick gum at the penny candy store.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧ (flat board) + ⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧ (gum). Refers to the traditional flat, rectangular stick form of chewing gum.

COUNTER:
Counted with ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ (counter for flat things): ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧、⟦{二枚|にまい}→二枚：30347_nimai⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {板|いた}ガム: stick/slab gum (traditional flat shape)
- ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧: pellet gum (small, coated pieces — now more popular)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {板|いた}ガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧ (to chew stick gum)
- {板|いた}ガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧ (one piece of stick gum)

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧ has largely overtaken {板|いた}ガム in market share in Japan. Classic {板|いた}ガム brands include ロッテ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧クール⟦ミント→ミント：09650_minto⟧ and グリーンガム, which have nostalgic appeal.
